uncited: Hierarchical Vector Quantization on Delta is a compression method for time-varying volumetric data that combines temporal delta encoding with hierarchical vector quantization (HVQ) to achieve high compression ratios while maintaining direct rendering capabilities on programmable graphics hardware.
The method operates on time-varying volume data represented as a sequence of 3D grids.
The core innovation is the application of delta encoding across time steps before applying the spatial compression.
**Base Frame ($V_0$):** Stored uncompressed or with standard spatial compression.
**Delta Residuals ($D_t$):** For $t > 0$, $D_t(x,y,z) = V_t(x,y,z) - V_{t-1}(x,y,z)$.
**HVQ Codebooks:** Hierarchical sets of vectors learned from the delta residuals.
**Indices:** Quantization indices mapping voxels to codebook entries.
**Temporal Delta Encoding:** Compute the difference between adjacent time steps.
**Hierarchical Vector Quantization:** Apply HVQ to the delta residuals $D_t$.
HVQ decomposes the data into multiple resolution levels.
At each level, blocks of voxels are quantized using codebooks learned from the training data (the delta residuals).
**Entropy Coding:** Encode the resulting quantization indices and codebook information.
-   **Bit count per voxel:** Determined by the range of data inside the brick.
-   **Resolution levels:** Determined by the hierarchical structure of the HVQ.
-   **Temporal Discontinuity:** Large changes between frames (e.g., object appearance/disappearance) result in large delta values, which may require higher bit counts or specialized handling.
-   **Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
-   **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
-   **Measured Performance:** Not given in the sources.
-   **When to use:** Time-varying volumetric data with high temporal coherence.
-   **When not to use:** Data with large temporal discontinuities or no temporal coherence.
The method was proposed by She et al. [SBN11] as a way to compress time-varying volume data.
It builds on the HVQ method [827-hierarchical-vector-quantization.md] and adds a temporal delta encoding step.
